summary: Iteration 89 — Alert Engine proattivo (backend + frontend) tested end-to-end. All 13 pytest cases + 1 seeded E2E case + full UI flow passed. Backend correctly handles token masking (never leaks), ignores masked/empty token updates, requires admin for writes, returns 400 (not 500) when Telegram is missing/invalid. Alert generation E2E via MongoDB seeding produced a vital_device_offline high alert as expected. UI at /settings/alert-engine loads, all data-testids present, save persists, run-now works and toast reports counts. Manage button in Settings navigates correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: alert_engine.py `_best_poll_record` uses async signature but no awaits — could be sync; minor.
PUT /api/alert-engine/config/{client_id} lacks explicit 400 validation for unknown keys (silently dropped). Acceptable.

Telegram token cannot be explicitly cleared via UI (empty is treated as 'no change'). If user ever wants to remove a stored token they would need DB access. Consider adding an explicit 'Clear token' button (LOW priority).
seed_data_creation: Temporary MongoDB docs created and CLEANED UP: clients{id=test-alert-engine-iter89}, managed_devices, device_poll_status, vital_offline_state, alerts. Fake telegram_bot_token in global config also wiped in cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alert Engine endpoints: /api/alert-engine/{config,config/{client_id},status,run-now,telegram/test,telegram/detect-chats}. To test alert generation, use the seed script /app/backend/tests/seed_alert_engine_e2e.py as reference — remember to cleanup.
